question:
Choose the correct meaning of the given idiom/phrase from the options:
"Give someone the cold shoulder"
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2**, i.e., "To ignore someone".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Give someone the cold shoulder"** means to deliberately ignore someone or treat them in an unfriendly manner. (किसी को जानबूझकर नज़रअंदाज़ करना या ठंडा व्यवहार करना)
 
 
• **Example:** After their argument, she gave him the cold shoulder and refused to talk to him.
 
 
• It is often used to describe a situation where one person shows a lack of interest or affection toward another person.
 
• The phrase conveys a sense of intentional neglect or avoidance.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2**, i.e., "To ignore someone".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: To treat someone warmly** (किसी के साथ गर्मजोशी से व्यवहार करना)
 
 
• **Example:** She treated her guests warmly, ensuring they felt comfortable and welcomed.
 
 
 
• **Option 3: To scold someone** (किसी को डांटना)
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher scolded the students for not completing their homework on time.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: To make someone comfortable** (किसी को आरामदायक महसूस कराना)
 
 
• **Example:** The host tried her best to make the guests comfortable during the event.
